reasons.plausibility: Introducing a minor Al dopant to lower sintering temperature and form a protective Al2O3 scale aligns well with known ceramic densification and oxidation-resistance mechanisms, though exact dopant level and scale stability remain somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: Clear benchmarks (densification, mechanical strength, protective scale formation) and comparison against an undoped baseline allow a straightforward test of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This approach directly addresses the question of reducing processing temperature and improving environmental resistance, providing a clear path for researchers to explore and potentially implement.
